children: Teva began trading its ordinary shares on the New York Stock Exchange and terminated its ADS program.
Ordinary shares of Teva commenced trading on the NYSE on September 14, 2026 under ticker TEVA.
Teva's ADS program terminated on September 14, 2026; each ADS was exchanged for one ordinary share.
Teva's ordinary shares continue trading on the Tel Aviv Stock Exchange under the symbol TEVA.
Investor relations information is available at ir.tevapharm.com for additional details.
